title: Plane dreams
content: Does anyone have frequent dreams about flying in a plane and sometimes the plane has issues and sometimes the plane is either really big inside with a TON of seats almost like a movie theater or really small? And it’s always extremely hard to get to your destination and u barely even get there anyways.. I’ve also had dreams about having to get on multiple different planes and getting lost and getting on the wrong plane. And another one I had where the plane was super small this time and there wasn’t a roof it was just like flying without a roof and u could look down of course and see the view as fly.. idk why I have these dreams. I’ve never been on a plane or even to an airport. But I dream about these scenarios a lot and wonder if anyone else’s plane dreams have the same characteristics as mine (like really big or small sometimes missing a roof ect)
